name: Indexed Evidence Replay and Reuse Reconciler

inputs.indexed_event: canonically indexed prior event with qualified evidence class, replay/reconstruction result, and observed predicates
inputs.current_requirements: current verification plus ecosystem predicates required by the consuming Goal Task
inputs.node_context: already-established node connectivity/route context; transport only

outputs.missing_delta: only currently required predicates not proven by replay/reconstruction
outputs.failures: fail-closed replay/reconstruction or route mismatch classifications

failure_remediation: Never rerun a sufficient path. If replay/reconstruction is valid but incomplete for current requirements, emit only the exact missing delta for existing canonical owners. If replay/reconstruction fails, fail closed without upgrading evidence.
